# The European

> > International business magazine covering digital transformation, global trade, renewable energy, and economic development across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

The European provides in-depth analysis of cross-border business trends, featuring coverage of major economies including China, the United States, UK, and European Union. The publication focuses on technology innovation, sustainable development, financial services, and foreign direct investment opportunities worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Digital transformation
- Foreign direct investment (FDI)
- Renewable energy and sustainability
- Brexit and UK economy
- China and Alibaba expansion
- Financial services and banking
- E-commerce and tech companies
- Wind energy (World Wind Energy Association, Stefan Gsaenger)
- Cloud computing and data centers
- Blockchain and AI
- European Union trade policy
- Economic development
- Australia and Pacific region
- Japan and Asia-Pacific markets
- WTO and international trade

## Digital Transformation & Technology

- [Big tech companies are not worried about Brexit](https://the-european.eu/story-15193/big-tech-companies-are-not-worried-about-brexit.html): Alibaba and Jack Ma's UK expansion plans despite Brexit uncertainty
- [Alibaba generated (US$38.4 Billion) of GMV During the 11.11.19 Shopping Festival](https://the-european.eu/story-19018/alibaba-generated-rmb268-4-billion-us38-4-billion-of-gmv-during-the-2019-11-11-shopping-festival.html): Alibaba's Singles Day 2019 record GMV on Taobao and Tmall platforms
- [Data: fuelling the new economy](https://the-european.eu/story-16119/data-fuelling-the-new-economy.html): IoT and big data's role in digital transformation by Virtusa's experts
- [Delivering the future of banking to Mexico](https://the-european.eu/story-14477/delivering-the-future-of-banking-to-mexico.html): BBVA Bancomer's digital transformation and fintech innovation in Mexico
- [ICC welcomes breakthrough in WTO e-commerce talks](https://the-european.eu/story-15813/icc-welcomes-breakthrough-in-wto-e-commerce-talks.html): International Chamber of Commerce on WTO digital trade negotiations

## Global Economic Development & Trade

- [Water – the real liquidity crisis](https://the-european.eu/story-18957/water-the-real-liquidity-crisis.html): World Bank and WEF on water scarcity as global economic threat
- [Global Spending in Construction to Reach $17.5 Trillion by 2030](https://the-european.eu/story-19083/global-spending-in-construction-to-reach-17-5-trillion-by-2030.html): Construction spending forecast led by China, US, and India through 2030
- [Jamaica: Taking flight](https://the-european.eu/story-14956/jamaica-taking-flight.html): Jamaica's Global Logistics Hub Initiative and Caribbean trade expansion
- [Costa Rica: Where innovation comes naturally](https://the-european.eu/story-15470/costa-rica-where-innovation-comes-naturally.html): Costa Rica's renewable energy, biodiversity, and biotech innovation
- [A one-stop shop for business](https://the-european.eu/story-18747/a-one-stop-shop-for-business.html): Invest Durban's FDI promotion services in eThekwini Municipality

## Renewable Energy & Sustainability

- [The World Wind Energy Association (WWEA)](https://the-european.eu/story-15418/the-world-wind-energy-association-wwea.html): WWEA conference in Karachi promoting renewable wind energy solutions
- [Wild Energy Concert fuels 100% renewable energy cause](https://the-european.eu/story-14885/wild-energy-concert-fuels-100-renewable-energy-cause.html): Eurovision winner Ruslana performs at WindEnergy Hamburg 2018

## Financial Services & Banking

- [Pound nosedives, UK recession looming – now is the time to protect UK-based assets](https://the-european.eu/story-18414/pound-nosedives-uk-recession-looming-now-is-the-time-to-protect-uk-based-assets.html): deVere Group's Nigel Green on pound decline under Boris Johnson's Brexit
- [Dollar climbs on U.S. oil stockpile use after Saudi attacks](https://the-european.eu/story-18507/dollar-climbs-on-u-s-oil-stockpile-use-after-saudi-attacks.html): Dollar rises as Trump taps petroleum reserves after Saudi oil attacks
- [Interview with Artem Konstandyan, Promsvyazbank's CEO](https://the-european.eu/story-7494/interview-artem-konstandyan-prom-svyaz-banks-ceo.html): Promsvyazbank CEO on Central-Eastern Europe banking excellence award
- [Interview with Wai Lynn Htoon, Head of Corporate Banking at Asia Green Development Bank](https://the-european.eu/story-10743/interview-wai-lynn-htoon-head-corporate-banking-asia-green-development-bank.html): Asia Green Development Bank's corporate banking head on Southeast Asia
- [Edinburgh: A leading European financial centre](https://the-european.eu/story-10516/edinburgh-leading-european-financial-centre-2.html): Edinburgh's position as Scotland's premier European financial hub

## Regional Market Analysis

- [The rise and fall of the Australian housing sector](https://the-european.eu/story-14407/the-rise-and-fall-of-the-australian-housing-sector.html): Sydney and Melbourne property bubble analysis by Demographia and Fitch
